images.A_book: Cinematic, highly detailed, dramatic low-key lighting, deep black and deep blue shadows, warm golden light, film grain, mystical spiritual mood. The main subject is large and placed in the left 45 percent of the frame; the right half falls off into near-black darkness for text. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no logo.
